name: GasNominationImbalanceDesk
tagline: Nominate every point on time, catch cuts early and keep each pipeline inside its imbalance tolerance.
description: A complete gas scheduling app in one PCF control: daily nominations by point and cycle (Timely, Evening, ID1-ID3) with deadline checks and the next open cycle, confirmations and cuts with reasons, firm MDQ and elapsed-prorata rules, flowing-day projections from measured volumes, allocation, a month-to-date imbalance per pipeline with tiered cash-out exposure and make-up guidance, and a point × gas-day matrix. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Cycle deadlines per gas day with countdown and next open cycle
Draft → Submitted → Cut / Confirmed → Flowing → Allocated workflow with business rules
Firm MDQ, confirmed ≤ nominated, cut reasons, elapsed-prorata rule
Bulk submit / confirm / start flow with undo
Flowing-day projection and measurement sanity check
Month-to-date imbalance, tier, cash-out value, penalty and make-up per day
Point × gas-day deviation and confirmation matrix
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
